description_en: Queries the HTTP/2.0 fingerprint information of a website
description_zh: 查询网站的HTTP 2.0 指纹信息
name: DescribeDomainH2Fingerprint

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query the domain names of all websites that are protected by Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的网站业务的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the hour or half hour
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return
parameters.name: limit

DomainH2Fp.description_en: The list of top N HTTP/2.0 fingerprints for the domain name
DomainH2Fp.description_zh: 域名Top N HTTP2.0 指纹列表

Domain.description_en: The domain name of the website

Pv.description_en: The number of times the HTTP/2.0 fingerprint is matched for the domain name
Pv.description_zh: 域名匹配HTTP2.0 指纹次数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
